name: Kerlee Baptist Church
addr: 208 Kerlee Heights Rd, Black Mountain, NC 28711

reviews.t: Great place to be! We visit every year when on vacation in NC. Pastor Ken and his members are inviting and caring. Our hearts go out to the members and the town as they recover from deviation from the hurricane. We hope to be able to communicate with them soon but until then, we pray for God to provide their needs in only the ways he can. -Brandy and Jonathan Gutierrez
HAD A Wonderful SERVICE & GREAT TIME, WITH FELLOWSHIP, And Enjoying A Awesome Luncheon!!
Awesome group of folks who love God!
Beautiful friendly loving church inside and out
